t: This is Our Lady of Sorrows, a Roman Catholic church in Peckham, with a friary next door. The Capuchin Friars founded it in 1859, and it's a Grade Two listed building. Since 2022 it has been the UK home of the Norbertine canons. It was designed by E. W. Pugin, the eldest son of the Gothic Revival architect Augustus Welby Pugin. Edward took over his father's practice after his father's early death in 1852. By his own early death in 1875 he had designed more than a hundred Catholic churches. His brothers Cuthbert and Peter carried on the practice as Pugin and Pugin.
